verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but it ships client-facing digital tools: the SCC Generator, the Term Sheet Generator, a HighQ deal room and a Legora-based AI assistant. Whether users can opt out of telemetry in those tools is therefore a fair question. The evidence contains nothing about telemetry, usage-tracking controls or opt-out settings for any of them. The privacy practice page describes legal advisory services, not a product privacy control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
